notes: These are logical JCS documents. Library-v4 supplies compression, sealing and row-key vectors.
Valid and invalid directory and title-approval cases pin den-core validation; merge cases pin convergence.
Migration and reset cases pin pure decisions only; they do not authorize a production split or minimum change.

validDirectories.name: one Owner and two Kids use distinct ordinary library-v4 logs

invalidDirectories.name: map key must equal stable profile id
owner field must name an entry
owner entry must have owner role
there is exactly one owner role
live profiles cannot share a library key
named maturity bands are not policy values
maximum age is a supported human threshold

mergeCases.name: later display stamp renames one profile
deletion is irreversible even against a later false stamp
greater key version beats a later stamp
later policy keeps its extension members

directoryOperationCases.name: create a third Kid through the uniform profile entry
delete leaves a permanent entry tombstone

directoryMergeCases.name: concurrent rename and policy change converge

policyCases.name: highest supported age allows at the boundary
minimum age above the supported human range is invalid

kidDiscoveryCases.name: child intent at threshold is relevant
child intent below threshold is not relevant
teen intent does not enter a young child catalogue
unbounded Kid includes child and teen intent
genre and technique alone have no relevance input
audience scores above one are invalid

validApprovalDocuments.name: one Kid has independent movie and TV approvals with extensions

invalidApprovalDocuments.name: title key requires a media type
title key uses canonical positive decimal
title key fits the store uint32 identity
logical document name identifies its Kid
approval target must be a Kid
approval value is allow or tombstone

approvalMergeCases.name: later tombstone removes an allow without deleting its key
a stale allow cannot resurrect after a newer tombstone
tombstone wins an equal-stamp tie conservatively
a fresh owner allow can reapprove a tombstoned title

approvalUnknownSetCases.name: unknown set follows the document with the newest approval stamp
nonempty unknown set wins when newest stamps are equal
byte-greater JCS breaks equal-stamp nonempty ties

approvalScopeCases.name: approval does not apply to another Kid
Visitor never consumes a Kid approval

selectionCases.name: sticky Visitor opens its local namespace
missing marker never silently opens Owner
unknown profile opens picker with restricted profiles
corrupt marker opens picker and never Owner
missing marker opens picker even when every profile is unrestricted

settingsPartitionCases.name: every assigned preference moves to its canonical destination and unknowns stay household
empty preferences create no destination values

retirementCases.name: a fresh committed directory can retire a distinct unreferenced candidate
an already absent candidate is idempotent success
the household can never be the candidate
a live Owner key can never be the candidate
omitting one live profile id invalidates the proof
adding an unvalidated protected id invalidates the proof
a malformed committed directory blocks retirement
a changed sealed directory row loses the atomic condition
an authority change after validation loses the atomic condition
a genuinely changed legacy fence can clean its abandoned candidate
the same legacy source cannot authorize cleanup
a corrupt household never authorizes cleanup

idle without explicit intent cannot start
backup precedes any Owner destination write
verified backup permits Owner creation
copied Owner must be verified
only a head-bound verified Owner permits commit
verified Owner without a copied head is rejected
ready journal without backup evidence is rejected
unknown commit is resolved by read
unknown commit reads before interpreting a changed fence
fence loser retires its unreferenced candidate
loser cleanup is idempotent then adopts winner
own committed candidate is verified instead of cleaned
own verified committed candidate activates
matching Owner key without matching immutable evidence is rejected
cleanup can never target committed Owner
cleanup can never target any other live profile
cleanup can never target a live adult profile
retired evidence cannot claim a committed key was deleted
winner is verified before activation
committed observation requires a valid stored directory
changed legacy fence restarts after candidate cleanup
malformed source fence is rejected
missing observed fence is rejected
malformed observed fence is rejected
malformed candidate key is rejected
noncanonical candidate key is rejected
null candidate key is rejected rather than treated as absent
null candidate attempt is rejected rather than treated as absent
null candidate head is rejected rather than treated as absent
null directory is forbidden for a legacy observation
null committed directory is malformed rather than missing
non-boolean evidence is rejected
retired evidence requires a candidate
legacy adopting phase is rejected as a contradiction
missing state is rejected
non-string state is rejected
missing observation is rejected
non-string observation is rejected
verified backup may repair corrupt legacy household
backup never restores over committed winner

resetCases.name: planner names every live profile still awaiting verification
verified live moves permit one successor commit
retirement answer names every old library and household still live
revocation completes only after every old library is retired
omitting one live profile is never permission to commit
duplicating one live profile cannot stand in for exact coverage
old key and version are bound to the directory entry

successor keys cannot reuse any old profile key
